svg.title: Figure 5｜Three acceptance criteria for an AI Coding Agent
svg.desc: These are specifications for implementation and testing, not tests already run or passed. The three criteria are parallel.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 5｜Three acceptance criteria for an AI Coding Agent
If a user runs a check with required fields missing, identify the
omissions. Do not show a complete pass or allow complete-report
If the user edits data after a pass, invalidate the previous result
. Do not treat it as current before rechecking.
If the user cancels the task, do not record cancellation as
These are specifications for implementation and testing, not tests
already run or passed. The three criteria are parallel.
